pairs: Pretend to be a character in a post-apocalyptic world. Describe how you survive and the allies you encounter.

The air was thick with the scent of ash and decay, a constant reminder of the world that had been lost. I spent my days scavenging for supplies and water, trying to find enough food to keep me going. At night, I learned to sleep lightly, ready to defend myself at a moment's notice. Along the way, I encountered a few allies who had managed to survive against the odds. There was old man Jenkins, a former mechanic who could fix just about anything, and a young woman named Sarah, who had trained as a soldier before the world fell apart. Together, we formed a makeshift family, relying on each other for protection and support. We spent our days trying to find a safe place to call home, a place where we could rebuild what had been lost. But the world was still dangerous, still unpredictable. We knew that we had to be vigilant, always on our guard against the dangers that lurked in every shadow. But we were determined to survive, to find a new beginning in this shattered world. And together, we knew that we could make it through anything.
